# ADR-3117: A10: Prefer network egress proxies for URL preview 9

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Per-service filters drift.

## Decision

Platforms SHOULD prefer network egress proxies for URL preview 9 (A10-9) when centralizing SSRF controls.

## Consequences

Proxies emit deny metrics.
